evidence: Changes CNetAddr::IsRoutable in src/netaddress.cpp and src/netaddress.h to filter multicast ranges out of address management and outbound peer selection.
rationale: Prevents multicast addresses from polluting addrman and wasting outbound connection slots. The commit notes that 'Gossiped multicast addresses were therefore accepted into addrman and could be selected for outbound connections,' addressing a minor network-level unreachability issue.
